name: Fair housing complaints by county and basis: Fair Housing Act cases filed with HUD, 2006 to June 2020
description: Fair Housing Act (Title VIII) cases filed with the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, January 2006 through June 2020: 130,661 cases counted for the nation, for each state and territory by calendar year, and for each county with at least one case, with the cases that cite each basis (race, color, national origin, disability, familial status, religion, sex, retaliation). HUD's list is one row per filed case; only counts are kept. A case can cite several bases, so the bases add up to more than the cases.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Fair housing complaints by county and basis: Fair Housing Act cases filed with HUD, 2006 to June 2020 (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23963466
keywords: HUD fair housing cases by state
Fair Housing Act cases filed by basis

distribution.name: fair-housing.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: fair-housing.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: fair-housing-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in fair-housing-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to fair-housing.csv on id.
